# ============================================================
# DOCKER RUN AND SERVER START COMMAND
# ============================================================
docker run \
  --rm \
  --name vllm-openai \
  -e CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="0,1,2,3" \
  -e HF_TOKEN="hf_REDACTED_FOR_FIXTURE" \
  -e VLLM_FLASHINFER_ALLREDUCE_BACKEND="trtllm" \
  -e VLLM_FLOAT32_MATMUL_PRECISION="high" \
  --entrypoint "" \
  --ipc host \
  --network host \
  --runtime nvidia \
  --shm-size 128G \
  -v /raid/hf_hub_cache/:/root/.cache/huggingface/hub \
  vllm/vllm-openai:nightly \
  vllm serve nvidia/MiniMax-M3-NVFP4 \
    --attention_config '{"backend":"FLASHINFER","use_trtllm_attention":true,"indexer_kv_dtype":"fp8"}' \
    --block_size 128 \
    --enable_auto_tool_choice \
    --no-enable_log_requests \
    --host 0.0.0.0 \
    --kv_cache_dtype fp8 \
    --language_model_only \
    --max_model_len 133120 \
    --port 8000 \
    --reasoning_parser minimax_m3 \
    --tensor_parallel_size 4 \
    --tool_call_parser minimax_m3 \
    --trust_remote_code \
    --no_enable_prefix_caching
